understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: Ein Geschwindigkeits- oder Kraftpfeil mit Ansatz an einem Körper oder Punkt gibt Richtung und Betrag der dort zugeordneten Größe an. Der Pfeilmaßstab und der Ortsmaßstab haben unterschiedliche Bedeutungen.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: A velocity or force arrow starts at the body or point to which the quantity applies. Direction and magnitude refer to that quantity. Arrow scale and position scale have different meanings.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Die Person liest Ansatz, Richtung und Betrag mit Einheit ab, zeichnet bei geändertem Pfeilmaßstab denselben Wert am selben Bezug und erklärt die veränderte Spitzenlage.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: The learner identifies the reference, direction and magnitude with unit, represents the same quantity there at a different arrow scale and explains the shift of its drawn tip.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Am festen Messpunkt eines Luftkanals zeichnet sie denselben Messwert in zwei Maßstäben und begründet, welche Aussage die Spitze über einen zweiten markierten Ort zulässt.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: At a fixed point in a wind tunnel the learner draws the same measured velocity at two scales and explains what the arrowhead can establish about another marked location.

descriptionReviews.rationale: Both language versions couple the same carrier or marked point, direction and magnitude to a given scale. The comparison at one instant makes the displaced tip interpretable. The local arrow convention stays bounded to the stated task.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: Die am betrachteten Körper wirkenden Kräfte ergeben durch Vektoraddition dessen resultierende Kraft. Eine Nullsumme verträgt sich mit vorhandenen Einzelkräften.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: The vector sum of forces on the selected body gives its resultant. A zero sum is compatible with individual forces acting.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Für winklige Seilkräfte zeichnet die Person Einzelkräfte in einem Kraftmaßstab, schließt die grafische Konstruktion und liest Betrag und Richtung der Resultierenden für den Ring ab.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: For angled rope forces the learner draws the individual forces using a common force scale, completes the graphical construction and reads the magnitude and direction of the resultant on the ring.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Bei entgegengesetzten gleich großen kollinearen Kräften erklärt sie das Ergebnis der Konstruktion für die Translation des Rings.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: For equal opposite collinear forces the learner interprets the graphical result for the translation of the ring.

descriptionReviews.rationale: The learner-facing wording requires a common body, force scale, graphical resultant and interpretation. There is no need to import torque calculation or a particular construction rule.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: Jede Quelle trägt am ausgewählten Feldpunkt einen Feldstärkevektor bei. Vorzeichen und Lage der Quelle bestimmen seine Richtung.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: Each source contributes an electric-field vector at the chosen field point. Its direction depends on the source sign and its location.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Die Person konstruiert am markierten Punkt die Beiträge in einem gemeinsamen Maßstab, zeichnet die Resultierende und erklärt anhand der Beiträge, welche Anteile sich aufheben.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: At the marked point the learner constructs the contributions on one scale, draws the resultant and explains which components cancel.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Bei vertauschtem Vorzeichen einer Quelle oder versetztem Feldpunkt sagt sie die neue Richtung oder Aufhebung voraus und überprüft dies mit einer neuen Konstruktion.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: After reversing a source sign or moving the observation point, the learner predicts the new direction or cancellation and checks it with a fresh construction.

descriptionReviews.rationale: The new German and English sentences locate each source contribution and its resultant at the same marked field point, require a common field scale, and retain interpretation through graphical addition. The earlier ambiguity about combining contributions from different positions is resolved.

descriptionReviews.proposedDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann an zwei Kontaktflächen Haften und Gleiten unterscheiden. Für einen gewählten Körper zeichnet sie die Reibungskraft entgegen seiner tatsächlichen oder drohenden Gleitbewegung relativ zur anderen Fläche ein und erklärt ihre Wirkung auf seine Bewegung.
descriptionReviews.proposedDescriptionEn: The learner can distinguish sticking from sliding at a contact. For a chosen body, the learner draws the frictional force opposite its actual or impending sliding relative to the other surface and explains the effect on its motion.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: An einem Kontakt wirkt die Reibung auf den gewählten Körper entgegen seinem Gleiten oder seiner Gleittendenz gegenüber der anderen Fläche. Im Haftfall passt sie sich bis zur Haftgrenze an.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: At a contact the friction on the chosen body opposes its sliding, or tendency to slide, relative to the other surface. Static friction adjusts up to its limit.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Die Person benennt Kiste und Unterlage, erschließt aus dem Kontaktzustand die Richtung, zeichnet die Reibungskraft an der Kiste und erklärt die Bewegungswirkung zusammen mit der Zugkraft.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: The learner names the crate and its support, infers the force direction from their contact state, draws friction acting on the crate and uses it together with the pulling force to explain the motion.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Bei wachsender Neigung erklärt sie den Wechsel von Haften zu Gleiten und bestimmt die Richtung der Reibung auf den Klotz vor und nach dem Losgleiten.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: On an increasingly tilted surface the learner explains the onset of sliding and determines the direction of friction on the block immediately before and after it starts to slip.

descriptionReviews.rationale: The unchanged description still leaves the receiving body implicit while asking for a signed direction of friction at a two-body contact. Opposite arrows are correct on opposite partners. The new card and existing profile now supply a clear convention, but the canonical sentence itself still needs that local clarification.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: Die Ortsänderung geteilt durch das Zeitintervall ergibt eine mittlere Vektorgeschwindigkeit. Sie kann in einem kurzen Fenster als Näherung für einen Zeitpunkt dienen. Zwei Geschwindigkeiten sind im selben Bezugssystem zu vergleichen.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: Displacement divided by interval duration gives an average vector velocity. Over a short window it can approximate velocity at an instant. Both velocities must be compared in the same reference frame.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Die Person bestimmt aus zwei kurzen gleich langen Fenstern die mittleren Geschwindigkeiten, ordnet sie näherungsweise den Fenstermitten zu und zeichnet sie an den jeweiligen Körperorten in einem Geschwindigkeitsmaßstab. In einer gekennzeichneten Nebenzeichnung bestimmt sie Δv von der ersten zur zweiten Spitze bei gemeinsamem Anfangspunkt.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: The learner determines mean velocities from two short equal windows, approximately assigns them to the window midpoints, and draws them at the corresponding body positions on one velocity scale. In a designated separate construction, the learner determines Δv from the first tip to the second with common tails.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Bei einem Richtungswechsel mit nahezu gleichem Tempo weist sie aus einer anderen Bildfolge einen von null verschiedenen Änderungspfeil nach und erklärt die Näherung bei der Zeitzuordnung.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: Using a different image sequence showing a turn at nearly constant speed, the learner demonstrates a nonzero velocity change and explains the approximation in assigning times.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: Zu einer Wechselwirkung gehören zwei gleichzeitig wirkende gleich große entgegengesetzte Kräfte mit vertauschten Ausübenden und Empfängern.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: One interaction yields simultaneous forces equal in magnitude and opposite in direction, with agent and receiver exchanged.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Die Person ordnet bei einem Stoß beide Kräfte den jeweiligen Fahrzeugen zu und erklärt, wie sich gleiche Kraftbeträge bei verschiedenen Massen mit verschiedenen Beschleunigungen vertragen.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: For a collision the learner assigns the forces to the respective vehicles and explains how equal force magnitudes are compatible with different accelerations for different masses.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Wird einer von zwei Magnetwagen festgehalten, ordnet die Person die Magnetkräfte beiden Einzelkörpern zu und erklärt verbal, warum sie sich im System beider Wagen aufheben, während die Klemmkraft von außen wirkt.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: When one of two magnetic carts is clamped, the learner assigns the magnetic forces to their respective carts and explains verbally why the pair cancels for the two-cart system while the clamp force is external.

descriptionReviews.rationale: The concise two-body formulation preserves simultaneous equal and opposite forces in both languages. The final profile provides the system boundary and distinguishes equilibrium from pairing without overloading this description.

profileReviews.reason: The cart moves 6 m/s left: both given arrow readings correspond to the same velocity while the two road marks stay 1.5 m apart. The airflow case changes from a moving carrier to a fixed sampling location and reverses the read/draw order. It independently tests the insufficiency of a measurement at P for inferring flow at Q or a particle path. The two independent demonstrations cover both expectations.

The orthogonal 30 N/40 N ring example gives 50 N, north of east (~53° north of east), on a 1 cm per 10 N scale. “Nordost” in the brief names a quadrant, not an exact 45° compass direction. The 25 N/25 N collinear and coincident pair tests translation at zero resultant. Inferring a general torque from the resultant alone is excluded. No torque calculation is justified.

Like-charge midpoint cancellation changes on moving the observation point; reversing a dipole source changes a local contribution on the same scale. In both briefs the source geometry and the evaluation point must be depicted or specified in the eventual tasks. The profile distinguishes source charge from local field, requires the reference point and does not import quantitative vector fields.

The 20 N/45 N crate discriminates adaptive static friction from the 24 N kinetic force, and force balance from relative sliding. The inclined-block transfer changes the contact geometry. The force is consistently assigned to the block. The basic rule applies to tangential slip of the surface of that body relative to the other surface. The cases require no fit of a friction coefficient.

The turning clip requires two actual Δr/Δt estimates, midpoint assignment under a stated approximation and velocity arrows at the corresponding body positions. In a labelled diagram the velocities of the same body in one frame are then copied on a common scale; Δv points from earlier to later tip. The second real clip changes direction at approximately constant speed, testing the nonzero change independently. The spatial/time calibration is supplied. Clip availability, actual pixel resolution and learner-produced work are not verified by a brief.

The collision now states that non-impact forces in the collision direction are negligible, so equal magnitude contact forces and differing masses support the acceleration comparison in the one-dimensional model. The clamp case explicitly distinguishes both receivers, the external support and the pair of internal cancelling forces in the combined system. A verbal account can fully demonstrate the law; a voluntary force drawing has clear anchoring and scale requirements. Both language versions support the same reasoning.

prerequisiteReviews.reason: In the actual book this new goal still has only the external “Warum Physik? – Weltverständnis & Zukunft” upstream goal. The orientation goal motivates the subject but supplies no technical competence needed to interpret an arrow at a marked point. I retain the scientific objection to making it a compulsory content prerequisite. An administrative entry convention, if independently required, would have a different purpose.

Physics of resultant/inertia supports interpreting a zero or nonzero resultant, and proportional quantities support choosing or converting a force scale. The common physical reference and reading a directed quantity from a scaled arrow are precursors to composing several forces.

The strengthened local field-point and common-scale wording makes the directed-arrow prerequisite concrete. Radial fields determine source contributions and the geometric interpretation of vector addition supports the local sum; full 3-D component calculation is not evidence required by this goal.

Net force/acceleration distinguishes the regimes in the loaded crate; balanced and unbalanced cases occur in the intended performance. The arrow prerequisite identifies which contact partner receives the force and supports depicting its direction. Quantitative coefficient determination is outside this goal.

Calculating a mean rate supports each interval estimate. Assigning a scaled arrow to a specific object position supports the physical sketch and precedes the newly explicit separate subtraction. Independent calibration is not a prerequisite because calibration is supplied.

Final Newton III permits the two receivers and single/combined-system balances to be identified in words, including the clamped-cart case. There is no independent drawing requirement, so the earlier objection to the lack of a new mandatory arrow edge is resolved by the revised profile. Newton II remains relevant for unequal accelerations at equal force magnitudes.
